verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a hosted email service that syncs mail to its own servers, so letting users choose a storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions region selection, data residency options, or storage location controls. Community remarks that all mail syncs to Shortwave's servers describe where data goes, not a user-selectable residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
